question: 'The God of Small Things' won the Booker Prize in which year?
solution: The correct answer is __**1997**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **'The God of Small Things'** is a novel written by **Arundhati Roy**, an Indian author, and it is her debut novel. • The novel was published in **1997** and went on to win the prestigious **Booker Prize** (now called the Booker Prize for Fiction) the same year. • It was awarded the **Booker Prize** in **October 1997**, making Arundhati Roy the first Indian woman to win the award. • The Booker Prize is one of the most significant literary awards and is given annually for the best original novel written in the English language and published in the UK. • The book is widely recognized for its innovative narrative style, poetic prose, and exploration of sociopolitical issues in India, such as caste discrimination, familial relationships, and forbidden love.
